summary: Electron launch issue root cause confirmed: npm workspace hoisting causes bundler to resolve require('electron') to absolute path, bypassing Electron's runtime interception. Attempted 5+ configuration fixes (externalizeDepsPlugin, build external, nohoist, CJS format) - all failed. Created web app workaround (vite.web.config.ts). Updated LAUNCH_ISSUE_ANALYSIS.md with 5 potential solutions (pnpm, remove workspaces, fresh clone, Yarn, post-build patch).
current_status: Electron app blocked by workspace structure. Renderer dev server accessible at http://localhost:5173 but crashes when Electron fails. Web UI partially accessible in browser without Electron-specific features.
next_steps: Recommended: Try pnpm instead of npm (uses symlinks, not hoisting)
Alternative: Fresh clone Auto-Claude and apply changes incrementally
blockers: Electron app cannot launch due to npm workspace hoisting
Bundler resolves require('electron') to absolute path instead of bare module
